headline: Ukrainian drones knock out Yandex AI data centres
body: War reached AI infrastructure. Yandex suspended its Vladimir data centre after a third Ukrainian drone strike in four days on its compute sites, which house supercomputers used to train its AI models. Physical attacks on AI hardware raise Catastrophic Risk, the main ingredient of Self-Destruction, and also lift Reversion while pulling down Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella argued that advanced models should be assumed compromised and contained from the start, with a mandatory emergency brake, a small plus for Alignment & Control. Horizon Balance fell to -7.90.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.8, from the Yandex strikes (+0.87), partly offset by Nadella's warning (-0.06) and smaller items (-0.04). Reversion +0.4, from the Yandex strikes (+0.32) and fading earlier news (+0.04). Libertarian Utopia -0.3, from the Yandex strikes (-0.40), partly offset by Nadella's warning (+0.07) and smaller items (+0.02).
